name: Xciel XCiPhone 17
summary: The Xciel XCiPhone 17 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) case for the Apple iPhone 17, rated for Zone 2 under ATEX, and for Class I Division 2 in North America. The phone inside is a standard Apple iPhone 17 running iOS 27, so it works with the same apps and device management as other iPhones.

certification.northAmerica: Class I Division 2 (separate part number XCiPhone17)

safety.conditions: Permanently sealed; iPhone cannot be removed without voiding certification. Charging and wired accessories only outside hazardous areas. Not for C1D1, Zone 0, 1, 20, 21 or 22.

specs.camera: 48 MP Fusion main + 48 MP Fusion ultra wide (2x optical-quality)
specs.batteryLife: Up to 30 hours of video playback
specs.nfc: Yes (Apple Pay + Core NFC tag reading)

specs.keys: Action Button; Camera Control; side; volume
specs.satellite: Emergency SOS + Roadside Assistance via satellite (region-dependent)

unconfirmed.specs.battery: Apple doesn't publish battery capacity. Figure from regulatory filings and teardowns.
unconfirmed.specs.satellite: Listed on Apple's tech specs; availability depends on the country.
